kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نرتسم (form VIII)
# نَرْتَسِمُ (nartasimu) /nar.ta.si.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَسَمَ (irtasama)
# نَرْتَسِمَ (nartasima) /nar.ta.si.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَسَمَ (irtasama)
# نَرْتَسِمْ (nartasim) /nar.ta.sim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْتَسَمَ (irtasama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
